facts.fact: 塔拉辛梦见一片如纺金般灿亮、缠着青绿薄纱的天，光纯得连空气都像在其中结晶。
facts.anchor: It was a sky as radiant as spun gold tangled up with turquoise gossamer, the light so pure that even the air seemed to crystallize within it.

facts.fact: 今天是和谈开始的日子，夜帝需要尽可能多睡一会儿。
facts.anchor: Today marked the beginning of the peace talks; the Night Emperor needed all the sleep he could get.

facts.fact: 从阳台望出去，她的花园在初升的日光里依旧挺拔明亮，而四周好几处建筑已成废墟。
facts.anchor: From here she could see her garden, still standing tall and bright in the rays of the rising sun even as several surrounding structures lay in ruins.

facts.fact: 萨多维亚与凯萨斯两支军团都已被打残，内纳瓦伦成了里尔这一角最后一支大舰队。
facts.anchor: With both the Sardovian and Kesathese regiments decimated, Nenavar is the last grand fleet in this corner of Lir.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克说要用余生把欠她的都补回来。
facts.anchor: I will spend the rest of my life making it up to you.

facts.fact: 瓦利萨要派使节来旁观全盟与夜帝国的和谈。
facts.anchor: Valisa was sending an envoy to observe the negotiations between the Allfold and the Night Empire.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛依依不舍地要走，阿拉里克反而伸手把她重新揽回怀里。
facts.anchor: So endearing, in fact, that Alaric curved an arm around the small of her back, drawing her close once more.

facts.fact: 往后的风会一直把他们送回彼此身边。
facts.anchor: Where the winds would always carry them back to each other.
